questions.q: What is the wider connective tissue band between groups of fibres called?
questions.explain: Perimysium surrounds fascicles; endomysium surrounds single fibres.

questions.q: How is skeletal muscle told apart from cardiac muscle in transverse section?
options: Large polygonal fibres with peripheral nuclei
Branching fibres with a central nucleus
Small spindle cells with central nuclei
questions.explain: Cardiac fibres are smaller with central nuclei and branch; skeletal fibres are large with peripheral nuclei.
